what: Pinned buttons and bars disappear while scrolling down past the header height, and reappear after waiting .3s once scrolling up begins. At the very top they stay in their initial state, and they appear when the bottom is reached (hide/show itself takes .3s)

options.--fx-dur-hide: look: different length only when hiding on slide (via style), default --fx-dur — Brand hide .8s · reveal .4s
options.delay: Delay before reappearing when raised (ms), default 300
options.offset: Hiding starts after scrolling this many px, default is the element height — add vh like ‹25vh› for a ratio of window height
options.look: slide type does not fade but slides up by its own height over .4s ease and hides (header row of a reference site)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Push length and curve of look: slide (via style), default .4s ease — a reference site’s header band is .7s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)
options.after: Hiding starts once this element’s bottom edge is passed (selector) — instead of offset. Brand uses the first screen #kv
options.--fx-ease-show: look: a different curve only when coming back down from slide (via style), default --fx-ease — Brand hide power2.out · reveal power2.inOut
options.step: Scroll that moves less than this (px) is not counted as a direction, default 0 — one reference uses 5
options.top: Within this height (px) from the top, is-fx-top is added and the header stays always visible — used when painting the header bar, transparent only at the top, with :not(.is-fx-top) (brand 5). If there is none, the class is not added
options.--fx-shift: look: distance pushed when hiding on slide (via style), default -100% (its own height) — a header row with space above needs a larger push to hide fully (Brand -350%)
options.end: If hide, it stays hidden even at the very bottom (default shows at the bottom) — Brand info line
options.look: fade-slide: Blurs and is pushed up by its own height to hide, and returns along with it when scrolled back up — --fx-dur default .48s · --fx-ease default ease (header row of a sample site)
